blocks.text: CEBU CITY — Choco Mucho’s Eya Laure and Sisi Rondina-Rosales just returned from practice for their club days ago after their respective Alas Pilipinas stints in the Asian Games. But the dynamic duo hardly missed a beat, carrying Choco Mucho’s come-from-behind 22-25, 18-25, 25-17, 25-20, 15-8 over revamped Capital1 in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Saturday before a packed SM Seaside Cebu Arena here. Despite struggling in the first two sets and failing to contain the newest trio of Bella Belen, Vanie Gandler, and Erika Santos, the Flying Titans remained patient and turned to Laure.
